title: Brown's lost 1929 paper The Minor Quantum

tellings.quote: In 1929, he wrote a paper. He was kind of cutting back, but yeah, in 1929 he writes a paper about the minor quantum.

plain: In 1929, according to Michels, the American researcher Thomas Townsend Brown wrote a paper called The Minor Quantum, which is now said to be lost. Michels brings it up in a documentary episode about Brown, a man he presents as a scientist who built UFO-like craft long before others claimed to, and he says nothing about what the paper contained beyond its title and year.
